name: print-social-carousel-olive-cream-interior-design-brand
title: Olive and cream interior design brand carousel
whatItIs: A six-tile carousel for an interior design company in olive green and cream, mixing a photo tile, service icons, a circular process diagram, stat callouts, team photo and a client testimonial.
whatItMeans: Cycling through photo, process, stats, team and testimonial tiles in one restrained two-color palette gives a services business a complete 'about us' story in a single swipe sequence.
techniques: sequence a carousel to tell a story arc: intro, services, process, proof, team, testimonial
use a circular/radial diagram for a repeating process rather than a linear list
hold a two-color earthy palette throughout to feel calm and premium
bestFor: interior design or architecture firm marketing

vocabulary.definition: a visual representation of sequential steps, often arranged circularly to imply an ongoing cycle
